title: Only Old Boom Damage
description: Respawn anchors, end crystals, and beds don't deal damage (but still break stuff).
body:
Stops explosions caused by end crystals, beds, and respawn anchors from damaging entities. Blocks will still be damaged, and explosions will still be caused. TNT, Creepers, Ghast fireballs, etc. will still work as normal.

Requested by `@szuofthewyldness`
